prose: In this enlightening equinox season, my solar return draws near, and what better way to spread the cheer than by catching up with one of the best teachers around, the great Eileen Day McKusick! Eileen is the founder of the Biofield Tuning store, creator of top-notch tuning technologies, and an all around fun human being. Joining us is Kyle Denton of Tippecanoe Herbs, a wisdom spreader and fellow initiate on the path of sound healing techniques. Don't miss this one!
music: Vibe Rant intro theme by VOLO
dropped: in the block (Sonic Slider, Biofield Tuning store)
